criterion: Reject any occurrence of Unicode U+FFFD.
Reject any code point below 32 except LF (10) and TAB (9). CR (13) is rejected. DEL (127) and other Unicode controls are not rejected by this rule alone.
Reject piece.strip().startswith('#') or startswith('##'). The second condition is redundant. No general whitespace exclusion.
Reject two consecutive backslashes or at least two backslashes anywhere in the original piece.
Decode each vocabulary token independently with safe_detokenize. Byte output is decoded as UTF-8 with replacement.
A detokenization exception produces an angle-bracket marker rejected by the predicate. An exception reaching mask construction produces an empty rejected piece.
Cache the Boolean vocabulary mask by model object identity and filter name.
None, an empty filter name, and the literal name none return no mask.
Unknown filter name, unavailable vocabulary size, all-rejected vocabulary, and incompatible mask length raise errors.
Convert scores to float64 and fully sort allowed token IDs by descending score, then ascending token ID. Rank is positive and one-indexed. Out-of-range requested ranks raise errors.
Count strictly higher allowed scores and equal scores at lower allowed token IDs, then add one. Excluded or out-of-range target IDs raise errors.
The historical helpers do not explicitly reject nonfinite logits. The stated inverse ordering contract assumes finite scores.
Safe-text filtering has no implicit special-token-ID exclusion. Ordinary sampling separately excludes exposed BOS, EOS, and EOT IDs.
The isolated roundtrip filter is a distinct additional tokenization test, not part of safe_text_filter_v1.
